title: Statistical Detection of Positional Bias in LLM-Based Recommender Systems: Methodologies and Empirical Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.37962v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as recommendation generators in conversational recommender systems (RS) via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). This flexible design introduces new sources of structural bias. This paper studies positional bias in top-1 and single-turn LLM-based RS: systematic dependence of the recommended item on the order in which candidates are presented in the prompt. We propose two complementary detection methodologies: (i) POB-ICM, based on contingency matrix analysis and Chi-square independence testing, and (ii) POB-UNBP, a sample-efficient approach derived from a uniformity null model under permutation-based evaluation, enabling stochastic decoding with formal statistical guarantees. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的推荐系统中位置偏差的统计检测：方法与实证证据
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.37962v1 公告类型：交叉（cross）摘要：大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地通过检索增强生成（RAG）在对话式推荐系统（RS）中充当推荐生成器。这种灵活的设计引入了新的结构性偏差来源。本文研究了 top-1 和单轮基于 LLM 的推荐系统中的位置偏差，即推荐结果对候选项目在提示词中呈现顺序的系统性依赖。我们提出了两种互补的检测方法：（i）POB-ICM，基于列联矩阵分析和卡方独立性检验；（ii）POB-UNBP，一种在基于排列的评估下从均匀性零模型推导出的样本高效方法，可实现具有正式统计保证的随机解码。利用一个基于真实商品目录、固定提示词模板以及 2000 条模板生成的用户查询（每条查询 20 种排列，共 40,000 个实例）构建的受控 RAG 商品推荐测试平台，两种方法……
tldr: 本文提出两种统计检测方法（POB-ICM 和 POB-UNBP），用于检测基于大语言模型的对话式推荐系统中因候选项目呈现顺序引发的位置偏差，并基于大规模受控 RAG 实验提供了实证证据。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two complementary statistical detection methodologies, POB-ICM and POB-UNBP, to identify positional bias in top-1 single-turn LLM-based recommender systems, validated empirically on a large-scale controlled RAG testbed.
